title: Twitch Blind Box Halloween Puppies
blurb: Halloween Puppies Twitch Widget: Streamer Chat Command or Channel Points Reward
description:
Halloween Puppy Loot Box 👻🐾

★ Channel Points: Reward viewers with a loot box they can claim! It also works with subs/cheers/followers (you can select which you prefer)

★ Chat Command: Alternatively, set up a chat command such as !halloween

★ Custom Limits: You can set a cooldown of a certain amount of minutes for each way of claiming the loot box, and if you're using cheers you can set a minimum amount of bits

★ Viewer Shoutouts: The viewer’s username appears in the animation to make it feel personalized

★ Collection & Leaderboard: Viewers can keep track of the puppies they’ve collected so far or check the leaderboard! This works with customizable chat commands which trigger a message in the chat

★ Rarities: Choose which puppies are common, rare or special

★ Fully Personalized: Change the font, colors, puppy names, audio and other settings to perfectly match your stream's aesthetic

★ Multilingual: All text can be edited, making the widget easy to customize for any language

★ Easy Setup: Quick and simple installation through StreamElements. Works with OBS, Streamlabs, and any browser-source setup!
